description: Searches the Art Institute of Chicago and the Cleveland Museum of Art open-access collections for works by one artist that the museum itself flags public domain / CC0, and drops everything else. Each work comes back with its museum id (aic:NNN or cma:NNN), title, date, medium, whether it is a line work (print or drawing, which also suits a white-on-black stencil), orientation, pixel size, the resolution it reaches as a full-bleed page (full_page_bleed_ppi; 200+ prints sharp), a thumbnail, the museum page and the credit line. The summary counts how many works print a full page sharp, which says whether the artist can fill an issue (about 8 to 12 distinct works for a 24 to 40 page issue). Living or recently dead artists usually return nothing: their work is not public domain. Example: {"artist":"Albrecht Dürer"}; {"artist":"Hokusai","limit":20}.
name: find_artist_works
title: Public-domain works by one artist, from museum open-access collections
